I am now looking for the next step in my career, a deliberate shift to expand my scope, expand my impact, and really focus on the people side of technology through engagement and delivery. I know I am a strong fit. I am asking you to take the chance, and if you meet me and disagree, I will accept that. I am confident you will not.

Nicholas Wood
